title: Witness encryption from plain LWE
formal: Does ordinary Learning With Errors hardness alone imply witness encryption for every NP relation, with witness-based decryption and indistinguishability of messages on false public instances?
definitions: Definitions and model details remain incomplete. Specify LWE parameters and hardness, uniformity and the witness-encryption security game; evasive LWE or obfuscation assumptions are not ordinary LWE.

import_provenance.original_statement: Can witness encryption for every NP relation be built from ordinary LWE hardness alone? A satisfying witness must decrypt, while encryptions of different messages must be indistinguishable whenever the public NP statement is false.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Editorial continuation of Sahai’s introduction of witness encryption. Evasive-LWE constructions use an additional assumption; this target is weaker than full obfuscation, so solving it need not solve the preceding problem.
